# vidIQ MCP

> Official vidIQ MCP plugin. Bring live YouTube, Instagram, and available TikTok intelligence,
> channel analytics, and ready-to-use creator workflows into your AI assistant.

The service endpoint is https://mcp.vidiq.com/mcp and uses browser-based vidIQ authorization in
compatible clients. This repository contains public plugin manifests, connection metadata, and
workflow guidance for the hosted service.

## Get started

- [Product](https://vidiq.com/mcp/): Official vidIQ MCP product page
- [Setup and usage guide](https://support.vidiq.com/en/articles/15082430-vidiq-mcp): Connection, credits, and troubleshooting
- [ChatGPT app](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_69dd11f3e50c8191b1ca48d03cf7e2ad): Official vidIQ app listing
- [Claude.ai connection](README.md#claudeai): Custom connector setup
- [Support](https://support.vidiq.com/): Account and hosted-service support

## Distribution files

- [README](README.md): Product overview, connection, installation surfaces, workflows, and support
- [MCP configuration](.mcp.json): Canonical remote connection
- [Claude manifest](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): Claude Code plugin
- [Claude marketplace](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): Claude Code marketplace entry
- [Codex manifest](.codex-plugin/plugin.json): Codex plugin
- [Cursor manifest](.cursor-plugin/plugin.json): Cursor plugin
- [Copilot manifest](.github/plugin/plugin.json): GitHub Copilot plugin
- [Copilot marketplace](.github/plugin/marketplace.json): Local and repository marketplace entry
- [Gemini manifest](gemini-extension.json): Gemini CLI extension
- [MCP Registry metadata](server.json): Official Registry descriptor
- [Specialist agent](agents/vidiq-mcp.agent.md): Workflow routing and safety lifecycle
- [Cursor lifecycle rule](rules/vidiq-lifecycle.mdc): Persistent tool-use guidance
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Public contribution scope and safeguards
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): Security reporting route and scope
- [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): Community participation standards
- [Licensing](README.md#license): Apache 2.0, with the Contributor Covenant adaptation under CC BY 4.0
- [Release validator](scripts/validate-distribution.py): Public boundary, manifests, skills, links, licenses, and secret-pattern checks
